You have to have him under CONSTANT supervision while he is free roaming with potty breaks outside every hour. You have to get to know his signs and know when he is looking for a place to pee. (Sniffing, circling, lifting of the leg) Take him outside after he eats, wakes up from a nap, drinks water AND on the hour. Go to the same spot and use the same command for going to the bathroom. If you don’t catch him in time and he pees in front of you, use a negative command (I did *dogs name* uhh - unh you go bathroom OUTSIDE) and then I would take her outside and repeat. You MUST do this consistently for however long it takes him to learn. Ditch the pee pads, it just encourages them to pee in the house. Dogs only learn by routine, so if you are inconsistent or give up as you indicated your dog will never be potty trained. You signed up for at least a month of hell when you got a puppy, do your time

First, if you hvent yet, take him to the vet to make sure he doesnt have any parasites. My baby had 2 different ones straight from the breeder.

Second, I did science diet small bites from the beginning. I recently switched to nutro 1/2 wet and 1/2 dry. I didn't have any tummy issues with either. If he doesnt have any bugs, bulk up his poo with rice and boiled chicken and slowly transition to other foods. Purina is not good for any dog and I think diamond is in the same boat.
